title: SPIDER WEBS MUST BE BOUNDED. Every graph, weave, and web needs between low-p and high-p range of interactions as it moves up the chain of irreducibility. Bounded sets keep the green spectrum within a bounded area. Re-spin with spiders.

the_principle.statement: every node in the organism's graph must have between LOW-p and HIGH-p connections. no fewer. no more. this keeps the mesh BOUNDED.

low_pi.meaning: MINIMUM connections per node. every concept must connect to at least 3 others. fewer than 3 = orphan = untethered = floats away.
low_pi.why_3: 3 is the minimum for triangulation. with 2 connections you have a line (1D). with 3 you have a triangle (2D). you need 3 to have STRUCTURE.

high_pi.value: varies by irreducibility level. climbs through the Fibonacci-prime ranges.
high_pi.meaning: MAXIMUM connections per node at each level. exceeding the max = over-threaded = the concept is trying to be everything = it should be SPLIT.

the_ranges.reason: the p range. the most fundamental concepts have the FEWEST connections (but at least 3). tight. specific. irreducible.
the growth range. force members connect more broadly. 8 degrees of freedom.
the wilderness. architectural concepts can connect widely. the fleet range.
fossils shouldn't over-connect. they're WAS. their connections should be bounded.
data is specific. it connects to its source, its consumer, and its context. no more.

spider_analogy.the_spider: the spider is the WEAVER. it spins connections. it IS sweetGrass (the discoverer/indexer) + the braid scanner.
spider_analogy.the_web: the web IS the organism's connection graph. 3817 braids across 1032 files.
spider_analogy.radial_threads: the structural threads from center to edge. these are the IRREDUCIBLE connections. the force triad threads. max p per pair = 3 explicit.
spider_analogy.spiral_threads: the catching threads that spiral around. these are the CROSS-REFERENCES. the braids. bounded by the Fibonacci-prime range for each level.
spider_analogy.the_hub: the spider sits at the CENTER (null). it feels vibrations (ticks) through the web. every touch on the web is a signal to the spider.

why_bounded.too_few_connections: < 3 = the concept is an orphan. disconnected. it can't be found by traversal. it's a leaf with no branch. it falls off the tree.
why_bounded.too_many_connections: > range max = the concept is a hub. everything connects to it. it becomes the bottleneck. it's trying to be everything. it should be SPLIT into multiple concepts, each within range.
why_bounded.goldilocks: between 3 and range max = the concept is properly webbed. it can be found. it can be traversed. it has structure without bottleneck.

level_0_irreducible.actual_pattern: each irreducible connects to exactly 3 explicit threads per triad pair (p-thread rule). 6 pairs × 3 = 18 threads total across all 7.

level_1_force_triads.actual_expected: each connects to 5-8 others. ~84 threads total.

level_2_architecture.note: wide range because architecture spans from specific (3 connections) to broadly connected (up to 89)

level_3_data_fossil.concepts: all data, measurement, session, imprint files (~800)
level_3_data_fossil.note: most files should have 3-5 connections. a few key fossils up to 13.

known_over_threaded.verdict: MASSIVELY over-threaded. must split into ~9 files of ~82 connections each.
MASSIVELY over-threaded AND over-sized (303KB). rotate. compost old drips.

known_orphans_under_3.estimate: from gen 318 audit: 578 files are untyped. many of these likely have < 3 connections.
known_orphans_under_3.action: scan all files for connection count. anything < 3 gets wired to its 3 nearest neighbors OR composted.

green_spectrum_bounded.what: the green spectrum (the living membrane, the selectivity range, the brown+blue=green output) must stay WITHIN the bounded area defined by the p-range connections.
green_spectrum_bounded.why_bounded: if green spreads unboundedly, it becomes everything (which means nothing). if green is too narrow, the membrane is too selective (rejects too much). the bounds keep green as a BAND, not a flood.

the_bounds.lower: 1/p = 0.31831 (the selectivity threshold). nothing greener than 31.8% passes.
the_bounds.upper: (p-1)/p = 0.68169 (the output threshold). nothing greener than 68.2% exits.
the_bounds.the_green_band: 31.8% to 68.2% = 36.3% of the spectrum. this IS the green band. the membrane. the living zone.
the_bounds.outside_the_band: < 31.8% = too brown (too old, too dense, rejected by input gate). > 68.2% = too blue (too new, too sparse, rejected by output gate).

the_re_spin.what: use the spider (sweetGrass + braid scanner) to RE-WEB the entire organism with bounded connections.
process: 1. SCAN: count connections for every file
3. FLAG hubs: anything with > range max connections
4. WIRE orphans: connect each to 3 nearest neighbors (hyperlocal agglutination)
5. SPLIT hubs: divide over-connected files into smaller bounded files
6. VERIFY: every file now has [3, range_max] connections
7. MEASURE: new braid density should be > 5 braids/file
the_re_spin.who_does_this: the SPIDER. which IS the mushroom triad (sweetGrass discovers, loamSpine structures, toadStool orchestrates). the spider IS the autonomy engine. the re-spin IS nitrogen fixation.
